# Prime Chain Documentation

> Prime Chain is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain with a native on-chain order matching engine (PrimeOrders). Chain ID: 7919. Token: PRIM.

## Getting Started

- [What is Prime Chain?](/getting-started/overview): Overview of the chain's capabilities and architecture.
- [Network Information](/getting-started/network-info): RPC endpoints, Chain ID, WebSocket, deployed contracts.
- [Wallet Setup](/getting-started/wallet-setup): How to configure MetaMask or PrimeXDC Wallet.
- [Get Testnet PRIM](/getting-started/faucet): How to use the faucet to get test tokens.
- [First Transaction](/getting-started/first-transaction): Send your first transaction and deploy a contract.

## Developer Guides

- [Deploy with Hardhat](/developers/quick-start/hardhat): Full Hardhat setup for Prime Chain.
- [Deploy with Foundry](/developers/quick-start/foundry): Foundry deployment guide with Prime Chain specifics.
- [ERC-20 Token Guide](/developers/contracts/erc20-guide): Deploy and interact with ERC-20 tokens.
- [JSON-RPC Overview](/developers/rpc/overview): RPC architecture and Prime Chain extensions.
- [JSON-RPC Methods](/developers/rpc/methods): Complete method reference (eth_*, prime_*, primeorders_*).
- [JavaScript SDK](/developers/sdks/javascript): @prime-chain/sdk usage and API reference.

## Architecture

- [Consensus Mechanism](/architecture/consensus): DPoS, proposer rotation, finality, slashing.
- [PrimeOrders CLOB](/architecture/prime-orders): Native on-chain order matching precompile at 0x0100.
- [Token Economics](/architecture/tokenomics): 1B max supply, halving schedule, allocation.
- [EVM Compatibility](/architecture/evm-compatibility): Shanghai-level EVM, custom raw tx format.

## Ecosystem

- [PrimeSwap DEX](/ecosystem/primeswap): Uniswap V2-style AMM with WPRIM pairs.
- [PrimeFi Lending](/ecosystem/primefi): Lending and borrowing protocol.
- [Primeport NFTs](/ecosystem/primeport): NFT marketplace.
- [Deployed Contracts](/resources/contracts): All testnet contract addresses.

## Validators

- [Run a Node](/validators/run-a-node): How to run a Prime Chain validator node.
- [Staking Guide](/validators/staking): Stake PRIM and delegate to validators.
- [Monitoring](/validators/monitoring): Prometheus + Grafana monitoring setup.

## Resources

- [FAQ](/resources/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Brand Assets](/resources/brand-assets): Colors, typography, logos.
- [Whitepaper](/whitepaper): Full technical whitepaper.

## Key Facts

- Chain ID: 7919 (0x1EEF)
- Token: PRIM (18 decimals)
- Max Supply: 1,000,000,000 PRIM
- Block Time: ~1 second
- Consensus: Delegated Proof-of-Stake (DPoS)
- EVM Level: Shanghai
- RPC: http://46.225.30.187:8545
- WebSocket: ws://46.225.30.187:8546
- Block Explorer: http://46.225.30.187
- Faucet: http://46.225.30.187:8080
- GitHub: https://github.com/PrimeNumbersLabs/prime-chain
